name: rayshot
description:
Instant screenshots with annotations: the hotkey (Ctrl+Print by default) freezes the screen at once and opens the rayshot editor over it, where you select a region, draw on it and copy or save it.

Needs the rayshot program, installed separately: https://github.com/paranoica/rayshot

Clipboard: the rayshot editor puts the screenshot on the clipboard when you press Enter, and the recognised text when you press Ctrl+Shift+C. The extension itself never reads the clipboard.
